# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the purpose and the changes made.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. State any checks that were not run.

## Impact and recovery

Describe relevant compatibility, security, data migration, deployment, or recovery considerations. Write “Not applicable” when none apply. Do not include sensitive details in public discussions.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and documented where needed.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand the changes, including any AI-generated code.
- [ ] Validation results reflect checks actually performed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or confidential information are included.
